statement: Grok Build's pinned ACP library implements line-oriented JSON-RPC message transport and normalization, while the shell exposes a session interface that projects Agent activity into ACP session updates for editor or process clients.

display_text.zh-CN: 固定版本的 Grok Build ACP library 实现 line-oriented JSON-RPC 消息传输与规范化；shell 则暴露 session interface，把 Agent activity 投影为面向 editor 或 process client 的 ACP session update。
display_text.en: Grok Build's pinned ACP library implements line-oriented JSON-RPC transport and normalization, and the shell projects Agent activity into ACP session updates for editor or process clients.

evidence.title: Grok Build ACP library
evidence.locator: ACP channel, message, normalization, and line-reader modules

notes: This is a source-level interface mapping; interoperability was not exercised against an external ACP client.
